verdict.rationale: Cloudflare provides a local dev simulator (workerd/Miniflare via workers-sdk) explicitly for developing and testing Workers separate from production, plus wrangler dev/preview and rollback tooling, and a separate Sandbox SDK for isolated untrusted-code execution — together supporting local/sandboxed testing without touching prod. However, there's no explicit documentation framing this as 'testing without touching production data' (e.g., staging environment with mirrored/synthetic data, data isolation guarantees), and no independent hands-on report confirming local simulator behavior fully matches production for data-sensitive testing. Missing for 10: explicit staging/production-data-isolation guidance, documented test-data seeding/mocking for bindings (KV/D1/R2) in local dev, and independent verification that local sandbox fidelity avoids prod-data leakage.
